learned: 2026-10-17: 7seazco.com/coas is one page of ~200 Google Drive file links grouped by year and category (flower, infused pre-rolls, vapes, tinctures). NY-only brand. Lab: MCR Labs (no reader profile yet).
notes: Link text is 'STRAIN - [LINE -] PRODUCT - SIZE - LOT #: 7SXX-MMDDYY-NNN'; flower strains are often crosses ('WHITE WIDOW x CHOCOLOPE').
Lot prefixes: 7SIF flower, 7STS Tsunami / 7SMT Mini Tsunami / 7STW Tidal Waves pre-rolls, 7SWR Wave Rider vape, 7SLT Low Tide / 7S-NT Night Tide tinctures.
